flaps._comment: A220-300 has 6 handle positions (0-5). Position 1 extends slats only, positions 2-4 are combined slat/flap takeoff/approach configs, and position 5 is full landing config. Speed values are provisional A220-family compatibility values pending redistributable public-source or vendor verification. The handle-index order needs in-sim verification against the target add-on lever detents.

lvars._comment: No vendor-published autopilot or MCP interface is available for this add-on, so the profile uses standard SimConnect fallback.

meta.notes: Virtualcol Airbus A220-300 compatibility profile. Powered by Pratt & Whitney PW1524G geared turbofan engines. Approach category D is used because the A220-300 reference Vref range reaches 148 kt. Weight data uses conservative BD-500-1A11 base values from EASA/UK CAA material; newer Airbus product material lists higher A220-300 maximum weights. LVARs are not confirmed - SimConnect fallback used. Flap handle indexes and some speed limits require in-sim verification against the target add-on.
